tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground behind everything.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Body text and headings, on background, card, muted, accent and primary-soft. Also the tooltip's fill, with background as its text.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: badges at rest, inline code.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, dates, counts, table headers. On background, card, muted and sidebar.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, inputs, checkboxes at rest.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card edges, table headers, the sidebar's edge.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, outline buttons and checkboxes; at least 3:1 on card.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one main action per view and checked checkboxes (also as text on background and card).

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and ticks on primary.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button under the pointer; primary-foreground on it.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Notice alerts; foreground and muted-foreground read on it.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover fill for ghost buttons, menu items and table rows; foreground, muted-foreground and destructive read on it.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar ground; foreground and muted-foreground read on it.

tokens.name: sidebar-hover
tokens.usage: Sidebar row under the pointer; foreground reads on it.

tokens.name: sidebar-active
tokens.usage: The row for the page you are on (aria-current="page"): a flat white pill in light, a slate pill in dark. Its text, icon and count keep their usual colours.

tokens.name: sidebar-active-foreground
tokens.usage: Text of the active row: the same as every other row (foreground). Only the pill behind it changes.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Late dates and counts, delete actions. On background, card and sidebar; a late count also carries a dot, so it never relies on colour alone.

tokens.name: destructive-soft
tokens.usage: Error alerts, destructive badges and the hover of delete buttons; destructive text reads on it.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus only: a blue of its own, so focus shows on teal buttons and ticked boxes too. At least 3:1 on background, card and sidebar.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Dims the page behind an open dialog.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Same as foreground. Kept so idp's existing class names keep working; use foreground in new code.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Same as foreground. Kept so idp's existing class names keep working; use foreground in new code.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Same as card. Kept so idp's existing class names keep working; use card in new code.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Same as foreground. Kept so idp's existing class names keep working; use foreground in new code.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Same as muted. Kept so idp's existing class names keep working; use muted in new code.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Same as foreground. Kept so idp's existing class names keep working; use foreground in new code.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Same as sidebar-hover. Kept so idp's existing class names keep working; use sidebar-hover in new code.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Same as foreground. Kept so idp's existing class names keep working; use foreground in new code.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Same as border. Kept so idp's existing class names keep working; use border in new code.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: Same as primary. Kept so idp's existing class names keep working; use primary in new code.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Same as primary-foreground. Kept so idp's existing class names keep working; use primary-foreground in new code.

tokens.name: sidebar-ring
tokens.usage: Same as ring. Kept so idp's existing class names keep working; use ring in new code.

groups.name: Senin
groups.note: Figtree, friendly and open. One family, four steps: 22, 15, 14, 12.

styles.name: pc-body
styles.sample: Send the contract draft to the Denver team

groups.name: Code
groups.note: The system's own monospace; no font file to host.

styles.name: pc-mono
styles.usage: Client IDs, secrets, error codes, job arguments.

spacing.note: 4px base. One row height for sidebar rows, table rows, buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: pc-space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a badge.

tokens.name: pc-space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls.

tokens.name: pc-space-3
tokens.usage: Between fields in a form.

tokens.name: pc-space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: pc-space-6
tokens.usage: Page padding, between cards.

tokens.name: pc-row
tokens.usage: Height of every row and control: sidebar, menu, search and table rows, calendar days, buttons, inputs and selects.

radius.note: Soft, three steps. Checkboxes stay square-ish; avatars and badges are round.

tokens.name: pc-radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes.

tokens.name: pc-radius
tokens.usage: Rows, buttons, inputs.

tokens.name: pc-radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and app frame.

shadow.note: Two lifts: pc-raise for cards; pc-raise-lg for menus, dialogs and tooltips; pc-focus for keyboard focus on controls, pc-focus-inset on rows.

tokens.name: pc-raise
tokens.usage: Cards and the active sidebar row.

tokens.name: pc-raise-lg
tokens.usage: Things that open over the page: menus, dialogs, tooltips.

tokens.name: pc-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control and row: a 1px ring line on the edge and a soft glow in a darker blue. Each control also turns its own outer 1px into the colour of the surface behind it (as on claude.ai).

tokens.name: pc-focus-inset
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on rows (sidebar, menu, search, calendar days, table rows), as on claude.ai: the 1px ring inside the row's own edge, only the glow outside.
